display_long_description:
Bring the wonders of the animal kingdom to your living room with Animal Kingdom! This virtual & mixed reality app lets you interact with and learn about fascinating creatures in a whole new way.
Experience the magic of mixed reality:
See animals in your world or in a realistic environment: Watch as life-sized animals appear right before your eyes, blending seamlessly with your surroundings or in a new realistic virtual environment
Learn through interaction: Observe animal behaviors, hear their calls, and discover fascinating facts about their adaptations and habitats.
Explore diverse species: Encounter a selection of amazing creatures, from majestic tigers and playful dolphins to giant dinosaurs.
Help us shape Animal Kingdom!
This is a demo version, and we're eager to hear your feedback! Share your thoughts and suggestions for features you'd love to see in the full version by emailing us at contact@octav.studio

Download Animal Kingdom today and embark on a wildlife adventure like no other!
